---
name: Template suggestion
about: Suggest a new plain-words template, or better wording for an existing one
title: "Template: "
labels: template
---

**Which deal is this for?**
Who are the two people, and what are they agreeing on? One or two sentences.

**New template or change to an existing one?**
If it is a change, name the file and quote the line you would change.

**Your suggested wording**
Plain words, short sentences. Amounts and dates as [PLACEHOLDERS].

**What usually goes wrong in this kind of deal?**
The argument this template should help avoid.

Please keep it free of legal claims: no "binding", "enforceable" or "valid", and no names of laws. Templates record what two people agreed. They do not say what the law is.
